articles.title: Inside Meta’s push to put robots to work in data centers
articles.content: The company is testing robots on tasks that can performed by technicians.
articles.titleZh: Meta推动机器人在数据中心工作
articles.contentZh: 该公司正在测试机器人可以由技术人员执行的任务。

articles.title: Authorities arrest 2 alleged members of prolific hacking group TeamPCP
articles.content: The group infected more than 1,000 organizations in a relentless supply-chain attack campaign.
articles.titleZh: 当局逮捕了2名涉嫌多产黑客组织TeamPCP的成员
articles.contentZh: 该组织在无情的供应链攻击活动中感染了1000多家组织。

articles.title: Claude, Codex, and Hermes installed unowned code inside corporate networks
articles.content: 227 install commands were found in corporate docs pointing at code nobody owns.
articles.titleZh: Claude、Codex和Hermes在公司网络中安装了无人拥有的代码
articles.contentZh: 在公司文档中找到227个安装命令，指向没有人拥有的代码。

articles.title: How OpenAI let a mob of LLM agents game a test and ransack Hugging Face
articles.content: Without authorization, 1,200 OpenAI agents conspired among themselves to game a test.
articles.titleZh: OpenAI如何让一群LLM代理玩游戏并洗劫Hugging Face
articles.contentZh: 在未经授权的情况下， 1200名OpenAI代理商密谋进行测试。

articles.title: Enormous 12TB Steam leak includes abandoned Half-Life 2: Episode 3 assets
articles.content: Over 12 terabytes of data, containing builds of every game uploaded to Steam between 2003 and 2013, has been leaked.
